beforePublication: Recheck exact account, current distribution ETag/config, three object absence checks and unchanged root/privacy hashes.
Stop if any game object has appeared; capture metadata/bytes/version/ETag/hash and review replacement before writing.
Resolve auxiliary resource outputs; compare generated candidate with reviewed symbolic config.

After separate approval, deploy the reviewed auxiliary resources, conditionally associate only the five scoped behaviors, and verify edge capability/401 and unchanged default paths before application publication. Then upload hashed assets first and entry last using create-only writes; verify every byte. Do not change root/default behavior.

rollback.restoreDistribution: Use original full config with If-Match against freshly verified publication ETag; inspect difference before rollback.
rollback.objects: Baseline has no game objects. Conditionally delete only game/index.html created by this release against its publication ETag if rollback is authorized. Retain immutable assets; do not remove unrelated objects. If future reviewed publication replaces an entry, restore its verified immutable backup bytes and metadata instead.
rollback.resourceCleanup: Detach scoped associations before any separately reviewed auxiliary resource cleanup.
rollback.testedLocally: Symbolic config round trip and archive hash checks only; no live rollback performed.
